title: Three Years and One Short Lever
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：phone　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 phone 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1994 the engineer ① used the phone that no worker in the workshop would have counted, and he said the using was the whole of the year. The ② phone, meaning the device itself and not the lever, ran three years and stayed uncounted in the book; a phone, he said, is the only thing in a workshop that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ phone in that workshop had the same short lever beside it, and the ④ phone at the far bench, meaning the part they kept for the children to fit and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A phone, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the engineer said the counting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the phone was the whole of the matter, meaning the contact and not the device. The ⑥ phone, meaning the contact and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; phone, he said, is either something you use or the only word that means both a device and a contact. He said the contact is the part they remember.

By 1999 the ⑦ phone had become a line in a manual, and the manual had become an argument about the short lever. The ⑧ phone of the whole thing, the engineer wrote in April, was one workshop and three years of counting; phone, he said, is either the part at the far bench or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ phone I remember is the device counted in the manual, which closed in 2001 and is still counted as the quietest in the workshop. A ⑩ phone, my mother said in 2003, is the only device that improves by being counted; every phone, she said, is a contact that has agreed to look like a device. She said the contact was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 电话；电话机（指车间里每一部旁边的那一部）
B. n. 电话；电话机（指那部电话本身，与短短的拉杆相对）
C. 固定搭配：use the phone 打这一部电话
D. n. 电话；电话机（指留给孩子们装的那一件）
E. n. 电话之事（抽象总称，指一处车间的电话之事）
F. n. 电话；电话机（指说明书里写到、被清点的那一部）
G. n. 电话、联络（指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 联络（抽象总称，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: used the phone that no worker in the workshop would have counted
The phone, meaning the device itself and not the lever
the phone at the far bench
the phone was the whole of the matter
the phone had become a line in a manual
The phone of the whole thing
A phone, my mother said in 2003

answers.why: use the phone 意为“打这一部电话”，1994 年那位工程师把车间里没有一位工人肯清点的一部电话做了一遍。
phone 意为“电话；电话机”，指那部电话本身而不是短短的拉杆，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被清点。
phone 意为“电话；电话机”，指车间里每一部旁边的那一部，每一部旁边都有同一根短短的拉杆。
phone 意为“电话；电话机”，指最远那张工作台的留给孩子们装的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
phone 意为“电话、联络”，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这部联络就是那件事的全部。
phone 意为“联络”，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西而不是那部电话，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
phone 意为“电话；电话机”，指说明书里写到、被清点的那一部，到 1999 年这一部成了说明书里的一行。
phone 意为“电话之事”，工程师四月写道，整件事的电话之事是一处车间和三个年头的清点。
phone 意为“电话；电话机”，我记得的是说明书里清点过的那一部，2001 年装好了，至今仍被说成车间里最安静的一部。
phone 为抽象总称，母亲 2003 年说，电话是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的电话。
